## Welcome to my portfolio !  

#### Who am I ?

I am a academic researcher in Applied Mathematics, Statistics, 
Machine Learning, AI, Computation Linguistics, Geography and Digital Humanities. I am 
passionate about mathematics, human and social sciences, computers, and education. I really enjoy designing 
mathematical models for various phenomena (especially in human and 
social sciences), implementing numerical simulations, and creating data 
visualizations.

With this website, I wanted to share some of my production. You will find here: 

 * Teaching material.
 * Data visualizations. 
 * Simulations and algorithms.

I hope you will enjoy them!

:::

---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml
from IPython.display import HTML, display

# Read data
try:
    with open('data/personal_data/cv.yaml', 'r') as f:
        data = yaml.safe_load(f)
except FileNotFoundError:
    data = {}

# Function to display the items
def print_section(section_data):
    if not section_data:
        return
        
    for entry in section_data:
        raw_html = f"""
        <div class="cv-entry">
            <div class="cv-year">
              <div class="cv-year-end">{entry['year_end']}</div>
              <div class="cv-year-start">{entry['year_start']}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="cv-details">
                <div class="cv-title">{entry['title']}</div>
                <div class="cv-institution">{entry['institution']}</div>
                <div class="cv-desc">{entry['description']}</div>
            </div>
        </div>
        """
        display(HTML(raw_html))
        

# Display both section
if 'experience' in data:
    print("## Experience\n")
    print_section(data['experience'])

if 'education' in data:
    print("## Education\n")
    print_section(data['education'])
```
